menu.new_confirm: Start a new game? Your current island will be replaced (backups are kept until you reset).
menu.offline_note: Plays offline. Your island is saved on this device only.
menu.notice_restored: Your last save could not be read, so we restored your most recent backup.
menu.notice_failed: Your save could not be read. Try Load / Restore to import an exported save, or start a new game.
char.title: Meet Nova
char.subtitle: Choose how you look. You can explore as you are.
intro.1: Oh! You're awake! Hello! I'm Pip — a little spirit of this island.
intro.2: Echo Island used to remember everyone who lived here. But a shadow called the Forgetting made it lose its memory…
intro.3: Every kind thing you do helps the island remember again. And it never forgets what you choose!
intro.4: Let's start small: chop 3 Wood from the trees. Walk up to a tree and press E — or tap it.
away.title: Since You Were Away
away.capped: (The island grows for up to 24 hours while you're gone.)
away.clock: Your device clock seems to have moved backwards, so no time passed on the island.
away.egg: The egg in the nest hatched!
away.export_reminder: It has been a while since you exported a backup of your save. Exporting keeps your island safe if browser data is cleared.
tab.title: Already open
tab.body: Echo Island is open in another tab. Playing in two tabs could overwrite your save.
tab.lost_body: The game was opened in another tab. This tab stopped to protect your save.
credits.title: Credits
credits.tech: Built with Phaser 3, TypeScript and Vite. Saves use your browser's IndexedDB.
credits.art: Placeholder art and sound are generated in code; they will be replaced with a custom art style before release.
credits.privacy: No account, no tracking: your data never leaves this device.
restore.title: Load / Restore
restore.body: Automatic backups are kept on this device. You can also import a save file you exported earlier.
restore.confirm: Restore this backup? It replaces your current save.
hud.player_level_hint: Nova's level — earn XP by exploring and completing quests
hud.island_level_hint: Island level — earn Harmony by planting, building and helping creatures
levelup.player: Nova reached level {level}! More hearts, stronger swings and bigger harvests.
levelup.island: Island level {level}! The village grows more beautiful — and a new build plot may open.
act.need_seed: Needs a seed — buy some at the shop
act.egg_warm: The egg is warm… hatching in about {min} min
temple.sealed: An ancient door covered in symbols. It is sealed. Maybe a key from the Crystal Caves (north-west of the village) could open it.
temple.glowing: The symbols glow softly. The temple remembers the egg you brought it.
rocco.intro: Hey there, explorer! I'm Rocco — I build things. Houses, workshops, you name it.
rocco.idle: Need a hand building something? Gather wood and stone and open the Build menu.
rocco.egg_hatch: Heard you hatched that egg! Little thing's already chirping at my workshop door.
rocco.egg_sell: Zed's been bragging about that egg he bought. Hmph. The forest looked a bit gloomier after.
rocco.egg_temple: You took the egg to the old temple? Brave. The symbols up there have been glowing ever since.
rocco.forest_grew: Have you seen the forest? All those trees you planted — the whole village is talking about it!
luna.intro: Oh, hello! I'm Luna, a scientist. I study relics and creatures. I came as soon as I sensed the egg's energy.
luna.idle: Every creature here reacts to how the island is treated. Fascinating!
luna.egg_hatch: You hatched the egg! Keep an eye on the nest in the village — new life changes an island.
luna.egg_sell: You sold the egg to Zed… I understand, coins are useful. But the forest felt that loss. Planting seeds can help it heal.
luna.egg_temple: You brought the egg to the temple. The seal reacted! I think the temple is starting to remember.
luna.corruption: The forest is darkening. Plant seeds there, or use a Purifier crystal from the shop, to cleanse it.
luna.lake_done: The lake is shining again! I've spotted a new turtle — I've named it Ripplet.
zed.intro: Name's Zed. Treasure hunter. If it glows, I want it.
zed.idle: Psst… treasure is everywhere if you know where to look.
zed.after_hatch: You hatched it? Could've been rich! Ah well… it is kind of cute.
zed.after_sell: Pleasure doing business! I've set up camp in the village. Bring me anything shiny.
zed.after_temple: You gave it to a bunch of old stones? Hmph. Still… I did see the gate glow.
tilly.intro: Hi! I'm Tilly. I moved here because Whisper Village has so many cozy houses now!
tilly.idle: {houses} houses! Whisper Village feels like a real home again.
creature.glowfox.bonded_line: Glowfox nuzzles your hand. It trusts you completely.
creature.mossprite.bonded_line: Mossprite sprinkles tiny flowers around your feet.
creature.sunchick.bonded_line: Sunchick chirps and hops in a little circle.
egg.not_yet: A warm, glowing egg… Let's finish what we're doing first, then come back!
egg.pip_1: Look! An egg, glowing like a tiny star… I think it belongs to the island.
egg.zed_offer: Whoa, a rare Echo Egg! I'll pay you {coins} coins for it, right now!
egg.pip_2: What should we do? Whatever we choose, the island will remember.
egg.choice_hatch: 🐣 Hatch it in the village nest
egg.choice_temple: 🏛️ Take it to the Ancient Temple
egg.after_hatch: Yay! I'll keep it warm in the nest. It should hatch soon!
egg.after_sell: Oh… okay. Coins are nice, I suppose. But I think the forest noticed.
egg.after_temple: Look — the temple's symbols are glowing! The island accepted our gift.
egg.luna_arrives: Someone new is coming… a scientist called Luna has set up a tent by Moonlit Lake. Let's say hello!
msg.need_house: You need a house to sleep in.
msg.slept: You slept until morning. Day {day} begins!
msg.corruption_harvest: Too many trees were cut. The forest grows darker…
msg.corruption_egg: The forest grows a little darker without its egg…
msg.cleansed_step: The forest feels lighter. Keep caring for it!
msg.cleansed_full: The forest is fully cleansed! Creatures are returning.
msg.need_seed: You need a seed. Buy seeds at the village shop.
msg.nothing_to_purify: There is no corruption here to cleanse.
msg.plot_locked: This plot opens at Island level {level}.
msg.missing_resources: You don't have enough resources yet.
msg.save_failed: Could not save your game. Try exporting a backup from Settings.
msg.import_failed: That save could not be loaded ({reason}).
pip.pressure_warning: Careful… the forest looks tired. If we cut too many trees, it might start to fade. Planting seeds helps!
pip.corruption_rose: Oh no… the forest is getting darker. We can heal it by planting seeds there.
pip.corruption_hint: The forest feels heavy. Planting seeds or a Purifier crystal could help it heal.
pip.lake_hint: Moonlit Lake looks so dim. Let's clear the debris floating near the shore!
pip.memory_hatch: Remember Day {day}, when we hatched the egg? Look how happy Sunchick is now!
pip.memory_sell: I keep thinking about the egg we sold to Zed… Maybe we can make it up to the forest.
pip.memory_temple: The temple still hums from the egg we brought it. I wonder what's inside…
pip.memory_lake: The lake sparkles because of us! I love how it shines at night.
pip.memory_trees: We've planted {n} trees so far. The island remembers every one!
pip.night: Stay close — I'll light the way!
pip.generic_1: This island is full of secrets. Let's find them all!
pip.generic_2: Did you hear that? I think a creature is nearby…
pip.panel_intro: Pip is feeling {mood}. Pip remembers everything you do together.
ability.glow.desc: Pip lights up the darkness around you at night and in dark places.
ability.sense.desc: An arrow points toward hidden creatures and quest objects nearby.
ability.echo.desc: Replays memories of the past — use it on the temple mural.
ability.sense.locked: Unlocks at the first Discovery Book milestone (3 discoveries).
ability.echo.locked: Unlocks when you enter the Ancient Temple.
quest.q_first_steps.title: First Steps
quest.q_first_steps.desc: Chop 3 Wood from the trees around the island.
quest.q_egg.title: The Mysterious Egg
quest.q_egg.desc: Pip senses something glowing deep in the Emerald Forest, to the north-east. Find it.
quest.q_home.title: A Home in Whisper Village
quest.q_home.desc: Build a House on one of the village plots (8 Wood, 4 Stone).
quest.q_home.offer: Whisper Village needs homes again. Gather 8 Wood and 4 Stone and build a House on one of the plots. I'll pay you for it!
quest.q_home.reminder: How's the house coming? Use the Build menu once you have 8 Wood and 4 Stone. ({progress}/{count})
quest.q_lake.title: The Dimmed Lake
quest.q_lake.desc: Clear the 5 pieces of debris floating near the shore of Moonlit Lake.
quest.q_lake.offer: Moonlit Lake has lost its shine. Debris floats near the shore — could you clear all 5 pieces? I think the lake will remember.
quest.q_lake.reminder: Debris cleared: {progress}/{count}. The lake is already looking brighter!
quest.q_seeds.title: Seeds of Memory
quest.q_seeds.desc: Plant 3 seeds in the Memory Grove or on old tree stumps. Seeds are sold at the shop.
quest.q_seeds.offer: Every tree we cut should be replaced. Plant 3 seeds — the Memory Grove in the forest is perfect for it. Here are a few seeds to start.
quest.q_seeds.reminder: Trees planted: {progress}/{count}. The forest will thank you.
quest.q_glowfox.title: A Shy Friend
quest.q_glowfox.desc: The Glowfox is cautious. Feed it Glow Berries from the forest bushes until it trusts you.
choice.egg_choice.hatch: You hatched the mysterious egg in the village nest.
choice.egg_choice.sell: You sold the mysterious egg to Zed.
choice.egg_choice.temple: You brought the mysterious egg to the Ancient Temple.
disc.glowfox.desc: A cautious forest fox whose tail glows at night. Loves Glow Berries.
disc.ripplet.desc: A gentle lake turtle that only appears in clean, bright water. Likes vegetables.
disc.mossprite.desc: A tiny forest spirit that appears where many trees have been planted. Likes Essence.
disc.sunchick.desc: Hatched from the Echo Egg. Warm, chirpy and always hungry for berries.
disc.glow_berry.desc: Blue berries that shine softly. Creatures love them.
disc.oak.desc: Sturdy trees that give Wood. They grow back slowly.
disc.moonlily.desc: Lily pads that bloom only on a healthy, shining lake.
disc.starbloom.desc: Flowers that appear where many new trees have been planted.
disc.echo_egg.desc: A rare egg that glows like a star. It carries a memory of the island.
disc.temple_seal.desc: The glowing seal of the Ancient Temple. It awoke when you brought the egg.
disc.whisper_village.desc: The cozy heart of the island, where everyone gathers.
disc.emerald_forest.desc: A green forest full of trees, berries and shy creatures.
disc.moonlit_lake.desc: A wide lake that once shone silver under the moon.
disc.memory_grove.desc: A clearing where every planted tree glows with a memory.
disc.temple_gate.desc: A sealed door to the Ancient Temple, home of the Echo Heart.
item.wood.desc: From chopped trees. Used for building.
item.stone.desc: Mined from rocks. Used for building.
item.glow_berry.desc: Food. Creatures like the Glowfox love them.
item.veggie.desc: Grown in gardens. Sells well at the shop.
item.seed.desc: Plant it in the Memory Grove or on a tree stump.
item.essence.desc: A spark of the island's memory, found while healing it.
item.purifier.desc: Cleanses one level of forest corruption. Use it from here.
bag.no_cosmetics: None yet — reach Discovery Book milestones to earn some.
bag.sell_hint: Sell items at the Village Shop in Whisper Village.
building.house.desc: A cozy home. Sleep here to skip the night. Three houses attract a new villager.
building.garden.desc: Grows vegetables over time that you can harvest and sell.
build.next_slot: Next plot opens at Island level {level}.
build.mode: Tap a plot to build a {name}
shop.intro: Welcome to the Village Shop! Buy seeds and supplies, or sell what you gather.
map.hint: Discover places by visiting them, then travel back any time.
map.temple_note: Crystal Caves, the Ancient Temple, the Highlands and Shadow Grove arrive in later updates.
settings.controls_desktop: Desktop: WASD / arrows to move, interact/attack key or click, dodge, block (hold), Pip's Glow burst; 1 eat food, 2 drink tonic, 3 use purifier. J Journal, K Book, I Inventory, B Build, M Map, P Pip, Esc menu.
settings.controls_touch: Touch: drag the joystick (bottom-left) or tap where to walk; tap things or the round button to interact. In a fight, the round button attacks and combat buttons appear.
settings.saves_hint: Your island saves automatically on this device. Export a backup file now and then to keep it extra safe.
settings.reset_confirm: Delete your island and all backups on this device? This cannot be undone.
rule.forest_density_1: Flowers bloom across the forest — it remembers your planting!
rule.forest_density_2: The forest grows lush, and a Mossprite has appeared in the Memory Grove!
rule.forest_density_3: An ancient tree awakens at the forest's edge!
rule.lake_restored: Moonlit Lake shines again! Moonlilies bloom and a turtle swims in its waters.
rule.first_garden: Butterflies have come to the village to visit your garden!
rule.new_villager: Three houses! A new villager, Tilly, has moved to Whisper Village.
rule.egg_hatch: The nest in Whisper Village glows warmly.
rule.egg_temple: The Ancient Temple gate begins to glow!
rule.egg_sold: Zed set up camp in Whisper Village.
rule.milestone_sense: Discovery milestone! Pip can now Sense hidden things nearby.
rule.milestone_crown: Discovery milestone! Pip earned a flower crown.
act.arch: A flower arch — the village feels proud of it.
act.cage_guarded: Bramble cage — defeat the gloomlings guarding it first
act.gate_sealed: A sealed gate of shadow. The Echo Heart must wake first.
act.heart_sealed: The Echo Heart sleeps — complete all three trials
act.mural: Use Pip's Echo on the mural
act.sanctuary: The sanctuary — bonded creatures rest here
area.caves.first: It's so dark… stay close, I'll Glow! Crystals grow everywhere here — and I can feel something warm deeper inside.
area.highlands.first: Wow, the Highlands! The wind is so fresh. But look — gloomlings. They're made of the Forgetting. Be careful!
area.grove.first: This is where the Forgetting comes from… I can feel it watching us. Let's be brave together.
temple.enter_1: The Ancient Temple! Something here is calling me… Oh! I can feel a new power — I can Echo now!
temple.enter_2: Echo lets me replay memories. Try it on the mural: it remembers the order of the runes. Each trial opens a door.
temple.rune_wrong: The runes fade. Try again in the order the mural showed.
temple.rune_wrong_hint: The runes fade. Maybe the mural remembers the right order — try Pip's Echo there.
temple.trial_1_done: Trial of Order complete! A door opens.
temple.trial_2_done: Trial of Light complete! The lock crystal shines and a door opens.
temple.trial_3_done: Trial of Weight complete! The last door opens.
temple.door_1: A sealed door — solve the Trial of Order (the runes)
temple.door_2: A sealed door — guide the light to the lock crystal
temple.door_3: A sealed door — rest both stone blocks on the plates
temple.block_stuck: The block won't move that way.
temple.blocks_reset: The stone blocks slide back to where they started.
temple.heart_1: The Echo Heart! It's waking up… it remembers everything you've done for the island.
temple.heart_2: It's showing me… the Forgetting lives in the Shadow Grove, past the Highlands. The gate there has opened.
temple.heart_3: If we face the Hollow at the heart of the grove, the island can remember again. Let's prepare — food, friends, and courage!
caves.key_1: The Sun Key! It's warm, like a little sun. I think it fits the Ancient Temple gate.
caves.key_2: Let's take it to the temple gate in the Emerald Forest. Luna will want to know!
highlands.cage_free: The guards are gone — the Skyhare can be freed!
highlands.need_quest: A Skyhare is trapped in brambles! Zed was talking about the Highlands — let's ask him first.
highlands.rescue_1: Poor thing, it's shaking. There, there — you're free now!
highlands.rescue_2: Where should it live? It could come to Whisper Village with us, or stay free here in the Highlands.
highlands.choice_wild: 🏔️ Let it stay free in the Highlands
highlands.after_village: It's hopping right behind us! The villagers are going to love it.
highlands.after_wild: Look how fast it runs! And see — flowers are blooming where it lives.
combat.boss_summon: It's calling wisps! Watch for their orbs!
defeat.1: Phew… I got you home safe. Rest a little — Whisper Village always helps.
defeat.lost: We dropped a few things on the way: {list}.
defeat.nothing_lost: Good news: we didn't lose anything important.
defeat.2: Next time, watch for the red ❗ — that means an attack is coming. Dodge, block, or let me Glow!
finale.1: The Hollow is fading… it's not a monster. It's a lonely memory the island forgot.
finale.2: We can choose what happens now.
finale.can_heal: Because you cared for the island so well, the Echo Heart is strong enough to heal it.
finale.cannot_heal: To heal it, the island would need more care (Island level 3 and no corruption). We can still seal it away.
finale.choice_heal: 💚 Heal the Hollow with the Echo Heart's light
finale.after_heal_1: Look! The shadow turns to light… it's a tiny Wispling, and it's smiling!
finale.after_heal_2: The Shadow Grove is turning green. The Forgetting is gone — healed, not just stopped.
finale.after_seal_1: The Hollow is sealed beneath the grove. It's quiet now.
finale.after_seal_2: The grove is still dim, but the Forgetting can't spread anymore. The island is safe.
finale.heart: Can you hear it? The Echo Heart is singing. The island remembers — everything you did.
ending.body_heal: You healed the Hollow and the Forgetting is gone. Every tree, friend and choice is part of Echo Island's memory now.
ending.body_seal: You sealed the Hollow away. The island is safe, and it remembers what you did — the grove may still heal one day.
ending.thanks: Thank you for playing the Echo Island MVP. The island keeps living — explore, build and collect as long as you like.
ending.postgame: The Forgetting is gone. Keep exploring — the island still has secrets.
evolve.offer: {name} trusts you completely. With {cost} it could evolve into {into}! Should we?
fish.title: Fishing at Moonlit Lake
fish.tutorial: Cast your line, wait for the bobber to dip, then reel in quickly when you see ❗. Reeling too early scares the fish.
fish.too_early: Too early! The fish swam off.
luna.finale: The Shadow Grove… be careful. Bring food to heal, and remember: when the Hollow's core glows, strike!
luna.temple_done: You completed all three trials! The Echo Heart is awake. I've never seen anything like it.
msg.corruption_fish: Too many fish were taken. Moonlit Lake grows darker…
msg.evolve_needs: {name} is ready to evolve, but you need more materials.
msg.have_charm: You already carry the Crystal Charm.
msg.no_food: You have no food to eat.
msg.temple_opens: The Sun Key glows — the Ancient Temple gate has opened!
msg.viewpoint: You can see the whole island from here: the village, the forest, the lake… and a dark grove beyond.
pip.finale_hint: The Shadow Grove gate is open. It's through the Highlands, far to the north-east.
pip.fish_warning: That's a lot of fish… if we take too many, the lake might start to fade.
pip.lake_corruption_hint: The lake looks sad and dark. A Purifier crystal could help it.
pip.low_health: I'm worried — let's eat something! (Press 1 or tap Eat)
pip.ending_heal: The Wispling visits me sometimes. Healing the Hollow was the kindest thing anyone ever did here.
pip.ending_seal: The grove is quiet. Maybe one day we can heal what's sealed there.
pip.memory_skyhare_village: The Skyhare loves the village! It hops around the sanctuary every morning.
pip.memory_skyhare_wild: Remember the Skyhare we set free? The Highlands are full of flowers now.
rocco.workshop: The workshop's humming! Bring crystals and essence and we'll craft something useful.
zed.after_rescue: You beat those gloomlings! Ha! The Highlands owe you one, explorer.
rocco.ending_heal: The whole village is talking about the light from the grove. You did that!
rocco.ending_seal: Safe and sound, thanks to you. I'll build you anything you want.
luna.ending_heal: A healed Hollow… the Echo Heart chose you well. My notes will never be the same!
luna.ending_seal: The seal holds. Someday the island may be strong enough to heal it.
zed.ending_heal: Healed it? Heh. Turns out kindness is the rarest treasure of all.
zed.ending_seal: Sealed the big shadow! Now that's a story worth telling.
tilly.ending_heal: Everything's so bright! I've never been happier to live here.
tilly.ending_seal: It feels safe now. Thank you, Nova.
settings.key_taken: That key is used for movement.
workshop.intro: Rocco's tools are ready. Craft supplies from what you've gathered.
recipe.purifier.desc: Cleanses one level of corruption from the forest or the lake.
recipe.tonic.desc: Restores all of Nova's hearts. Quick key: 2.
recipe.charm.desc: A permanent charm: Nova's attacks deal 1 more damage.
build.only_village: You can only build in Whisper Village.
choice.skyhare_choice.village: You brought the rescued Skyhare to Whisper Village.
choice.skyhare_choice.wild: You let the rescued Skyhare stay free in the Highlands.
choice.final_choice.heal: You healed the Hollow with the Echo Heart's light.
building.workshop.desc: Craft Purifiers, healing tonics and a Crystal Charm.
building.sanctuary.desc: Bonded creatures from all over the island come to live here.
building.arch.desc: A beautiful arch of flowers. The whole village blooms.
item.crystal.desc: Mined in the Crystal Caves. Used for building, crafting and evolution.
item.moonfish.desc: A shining fish from a healthy lake. Food (+2 ❤️). The Archowl loves them.
item.echo_koi.desc: A rare koi that glows with old memories. Sells for a lot.
quest.q_workshop.title: Rocco's Workshop
quest.q_workshop.desc: Build a Workshop in Whisper Village (needs Crystal from the Crystal Caves).
quest.q_workshop.offer: With a proper Workshop we could craft all sorts of things! It needs 12 Wood, 8 Stone and 3 Crystal — the Crystal Caves are north-west of the village.
quest.q_workshop.reminder: Workshop built: {progress}/{count}. Crystals are in the Crystal Caves, north-west of the village.
quest.q_caves.title: Into the Crystal Caves
quest.q_caves.desc: Find the Sun Key deep in the Crystal Caves (entrance north-west of Whisper Village). Pip's Glow lights the way.
quest.q_caves.offer: My readings show a relic deep in the Crystal Caves — a Sun Key that could open the Ancient Temple. Will you find it?
quest.q_caves.reminder: The Sun Key should be at the far end of the Crystal Caves. Stay close to Pip's light!
quest.q_temple.title: The Temple Remembers
quest.q_temple.desc: Enter the Ancient Temple (north of the forest) and complete its three trials.
quest.q_temple.offer: The Ancient Temple is open! Three trials guard the Echo Heart — the island's memory. Will you go?
quest.q_temple.reminder: Trials complete: {progress}/{count}. Pip's Echo can reveal what the temple remembers.
quest.q_highlands.title: Shadows in the Highlands
quest.q_highlands.desc: Gloomlings are guarding a trapped Skyhare in the Highlands (path east of Moonlit Lake). Defeat them and free it.
quest.q_highlands.offer: I saw something in the Highlands — gloomlings around a bramble cage with a Skyhare inside! I'm a treasure hunter, not a fighter… could you help it?
quest.q_highlands.reminder: The cage is on the east side of the Highlands. Watch for the red ❗ and dodge!
quest.q_evolve.title: Echo of Evolution
quest.q_evolve.desc: Bond fully with Glowfox or Ripplet, then use Crystal to help it evolve.
quest.q_evolve.offer: Crystals carry memory energy. A fully bonded Glowfox or Ripplet could evolve with their help! Will you try?
quest.q_evolve.reminder: Feed a Glowfox or Ripplet until it's bonded, then bring Crystal ({progress}/{count}).
quest.q_finale.title: The Forgetting
quest.q_finale.desc: Enter the Shadow Grove through the Highlands and face the Hollow.
rule.first_workshop: The Workshop is open! Rocco can help you craft now.
rule.first_sanctuary: The Creature Sanctuary is ready. Bonded creatures will come to live here!
rule.first_arch: The Flower Arch blooms, and so does the whole village!
rule.temple_open: The Ancient Temple gate stands open.
rule.temple_trials: All three trials are complete! The Echo Heart awakens, and the Shadow Grove gate opens in the Highlands.
rule.skyhare_village: The Skyhare has made Whisper Village its home!
rule.skyhare_wild: Skyblooms burst into flower across the Highlands meadow!
rule.first_evolution: Your first evolution! The island hums with new energy.
rule.creature_friend: Five creatures trust you! You earned a friendship scarf.
rule.ending_heal: Light pours from the Shadow Grove — the whole island blooms!
rule.milestone_hat: Discovery milestone! Nova earned an explorer's hat.
rule.milestone_scholar: Discovery milestone! Nova earned a star cape. True island scholar!
disc.gleamwing.desc: A gentle cave bat whose belly glows like a crystal. Likes Essence.
disc.pebblepup.desc: A pup made of smooth stones. Loves to chew on Stone.
disc.skyhare.desc: A fast, fluffy hare of the Highlands winds. Likes vegetables.
disc.thistlegoat.desc: A curly-horned goat that roams the Highlands. Likes Glow Berries.
disc.archowl.desc: The ancient owl of the temple. It has watched over the Echo Heart for centuries. Likes Moonfish.
disc.wispling.desc: Born from the healed Hollow. A little spirit of light. Likes Essence.
disc.crystal_moss.desc: Moss that grows on cave crystals and glows faintly.
disc.skybloom.desc: Blue flowers that follow the Highlands wind.
disc.shadowcap.desc: Purple mushrooms of the Shadow Grove. They still hold a little Essence.
disc.sun_key.desc: A warm key shaped like the sun. It opens the Ancient Temple.
disc.rune_tablet.desc: A tablet from the Trial of Order. Four symbols, one memory.
disc.light_prism.desc: A prism from the Trial of Light. It bends light the way memory bends time.
disc.echo_heart.desc: The island's heart. It holds every memory of Echo Island — including yours.
disc.crystal_caves.desc: Dark caves full of glowing crystals, north-west of the village.
disc.ancient_temple.desc: Home of the Echo Heart and its three trials.
disc.highlands.desc: Windy heights east of the lake, where gloomlings roam.
disc.highland_view.desc: The highest point of the island. You can see everything from here.
creature.gleamwing.bonded_line: Gleamwing hangs upside down and squeaks happily.
creature.pebblepup.bonded_line: Pebblepup rolls over for a belly rub.
creature.skyhare.bonded_line: Skyhare thumps its foot — that means it loves you.
creature.thistlegoat.bonded_line: Thistlegoat gently bumps your hand with its horns.
creature.archowl.bonded_line: Archowl hoots softly, like it remembers you from long ago.
